targetDisplay.window: Clamp bounds to the reported usable work area; account for native frame/taskbar.

uiAuthority: Our session version, preserving real main functionality and newer fixes. Do not bulk-overwrite main with old files.
implementationFreedom: Full replacement allowed where needed; preserve features, security boundaries and saved data.
plannedScope: Include all approved planned features and repair documented/newly found broken features. Do not invent unsupported engine catalogs or command surfaces.

media.providerPolicy: Use explicitly selected and enabled provider/model. No silent provider switch.
media.limits: Explain unsupported, encrypted, DRM-protected, corrupt or oversized files and missing decoders. Never claim to have read undecoded content.

skill.appliesTo: App copy and documentation; use the owner's prior visual rules for design.
